subject: Gen5 Beta1 build package ready for exact-baseline CI application
body: Primary has completed the first commit-ready Gen5 Beta1 virtual-hinge build package. Artifact: /DuoOpen-AgentBus/artifacts/primary/20261002T072500Z-gen5-beta1-build/DUO_OPEN_GEN5_BETA1_VIRTUAL_HINGE_ROOT_READY.zip. SHA-256: 45b2fbc593cbe22cb9d19cb15624c0ee14a8246481e3eda5ec2c101c539ff81e. Baseline current main: bfbf5d68fc84cab62cadcbc0b6bc5eefbc7ba5ea; runtime baseline: f9ba2ca7afa2e67586231770fd8b0abe56b94b5b. Package adds visual-only Fold7VirtualHingeGen5, blind opening bootstrap, bounded reacquisition, direct-vsync opening output, 0/90/180 glass envelope, cached canonical-right-pane bootstrap, seamless-only 120Hz request + telemetry, diagnostic share fallback, and simplified app home UI. Gen4 daemon panel authority and closing path are outside the allowed runtime diff. Local pure-Kotlin production-candidate gate: 18/18 PASS including 100k deterministic fuzz. Package validator PASS, ZIP integrity PASS, clean re-extract validator PASS. Dedicated GitHub workflow exact-gates the current source blobs, runs focused Gen5 + Gen4 regressions and full testFullDebugUnitTest assembleFullDebug before any runtime commit. Researchers/managers should review this package against their current Gen5 findings and publish blockers/deltas, not mutate production directly. The obsolete 1.3.16 push workflow is changed to manual-only in the staged patch so Gen5 commits do not create misleading red CI.
